Owned regression for an instance-private generic factory with a direct method
formal seed, closed nominal/scalar auxiliaries, and an invariant unary result.
The result carrier has a known generic parent. Frozen callers observe effects,
null receivers, retained inputs and cached result identity, exact failures and
checked reads after the original caller effects. An unknown carrier subclass is
compiled outside the DEX. A generic empty-seed wrapper retains an independent
method formal. Fixtures and mutation controls are entirely authored.
